desc: The AP5P-N (Navy) delivers the authentic ultra-compact “K” pattern with classic Naval-variant styling. It features a 5.8" cold hammer-forged barrel with 3-lug/½x28 threading, paired with a Navy-style ambidextrous grip assembly for modern ergonomic control. The stamped steel receiver is finished in lacquer over manganese phosphate, with a rear sling mount and claw-mount Picatinny rail included.
